searchText: Neither, I was genesis syncing to head, then shut down my node for a couple of days and the restarted. During the catch up the node took ~3 minutes to sync 4 minutes worth of blocks I'm syncing lh/geth now, and it does seem really slow, has anyone else experienced this on a different pair? ah you were saying it's slow near the head - just had 14 mins worth of blocks (and 38 blobs) synced in 12 secs, doesn't seem super slow, maybe there were more blobs? we should be roughly as full as when marius was syncing tbh, almost every slot has blobs in them does anyone know how I can send an invalid blob? and also a valid one? what tool is yall using? invalid blob would be invalidated imo you would probably need a client that accepts it This is how we send blobs, thanks to <@277500722655002624>'s tool: https://github.com/ethpandaops/4844-testnet/blob/master/scripts/run.zsh#L264 I think if you wanna submit invalid ones, marius's tx-fuzz is probably your best bet: https://github.com/MariusVanDerWijden/tx-fuzz/pull/8 thanks guys, will try sending good ones first
